scope: Algebraic components for parallel centered moments, affine view, and a specific globally centered triple-product nuisance. Not a whole-module certificate.

claims: --reals forall a b x y u v. (a+b)*(a*x*u+b*y*v)-(a*x+b*y)*(a*u+b*v) = a*b*(x-y)*(u-v) :: true or false = true
--reals forall x y m n a b c d. (a*(x+b)-a*(m+b))*(c*(y+d)-c*(n+d))=a*c*(x-m)*(y-n) :: true or false = true
--reals forall l b m. ((1+m)/4)*((1+b-b*m)*(l+b-b*m)+(-1+b-b*m)*(-l+b-b*m))-((1-m)/4)*((1-b-b*m)*(-l-b-b*m)+(-1-b-b*m)*(l-b-b*m)) = l+b^2*(m^3-m) :: true or false = true
